description.purpose: Pushes on events only: a new version of an active row is announced to the graph space (`source_changed`) and memory is asked for its facts (`facts`); their answer (`in_facts`) renders the brief and pushes it to the curator (`candidate`, in the row's round) and the aliases to memory (`alias`) -- each only when its hash changed, written first by compare-and-set. A retired active row withdraws its candidate and tombs its source.
description.use_when: Inside an objects hive only, behind `changed`, `in_facts`, `alias_ack` and `rendered`.
description.not_in_scope: No clock, no write of a row, no round decision beyond the row's own round.
description.emits_meaning: `push_store` to `./store`, `brief_render` to `./brief`, and out of the hive `source_changed`, `facts`, `candidate`, `alias`.
description.consumes_meaning: A changed row, memory's answer about an object (`in_facts`: the bundle JSON in `system.memory.bundle.text`, or a refusal), an alias acknowledgement, a rendered brief, and the store's answers.
